answer: What if every mask on this stage must carry a lantern lit by a juniper branch, signed in quill by an elder player who stakes his own bond on the bearer? One lantern lights one mask; ten clones need ten lanterns and ten bonds, and if one bearer cheats, every lantern his signer lit goes dark and the signer's whole bond burns. Ten masks cost ten bonds and one fraud loses all ten. One honest player, one lantern, keeps his wage.
